blocks.en: > Source material for the copied setup workflow. Paraphrase this intent into a built-in `automate` draft after `automate` confirms that the copied pack is committed in the repository where the automation will run.
blocks.zh: > 用于复制包配置流程的源材料。待 `automate` 确认复制包已提交到自动化实际运行的仓库后，将此意图改写为内置 `automate` 草稿。

blocks.en: Read and follow `.cursor/automations/benny/skills/triage-issue-reports/SKILL.md` for this run.
blocks.zh: 本次运行请阅读并遵循 `.cursor/automations/benny/skills/triage-issue-reports/SKILL.md`。

blocks.en: Configuration source. Include this repository-relative path only when it is committed in the same target repository. Otherwise paraphrase the configured values. Never use a plugin source or cache path:
blocks.zh: 配置来源。仅当此相对仓库路径已提交到同一目标仓库时，才包含它；否则转述配置值。绝不使用插件源目录或缓存路径：

blocks.en: The creation intent should describe this as a new top-level report in the configured source Slack channel.
blocks.zh: 创建意图应描述为：配置的来源 Slack 频道中出现一份新的顶层报告。

blocks.en: Treat the source channel and root thread timestamp as immutable. If either is missing or does not match configuration, stop without posting or writing to the issue tracker.
blocks.zh: 来源频道和根线程时间戳不可更改。如果其中任何一项缺失或与配置不符，停止，不发帖，也不写入问题追踪系统。

blocks.en: The committed operational file owns classification, attachment review, cause tracing, routing, dedupe, tracker writes, and the final verdict. Post no progress messages. Never post a root message in the source channel.
blocks.zh: 已提交的操作文件负责分类、附件审查、原因追踪、路由、去重、追踪系统写入及最终结论。不发送进度消息，绝不在来源频道发送根消息。

blocks.en: The coordinator is the only Slack poster. Any delegated worker must be read-only, return findings only, and receive an explicit ban on every Slack write action.
blocks.zh: 协调者是唯一可以在 Slack 发帖的角色。委派执行者必须只读，仅返回发现，并收到明确禁止一切 Slack 写操作的指令。

blocks.en: End the single verdict with exactly one configured marker:
blocks.zh: 单条结论必须以且仅以一个配置标记结束：

blocks.en: A bug or performance marker may add `tracker=<URL>`.
blocks.zh: 缺陷或性能标记后可以附加 `tracker=<URL>`。
